notes: The post has no section headers; its first blocks (Profit From This Or Be Destroyed, Audience Chamber, Jabba's Palace, Home One DB, Tatooine DB, Hoth DB, then HFTMF, Insurrection, Wise Advice, Your Insight Serves You Well) are the usual Profit starting cards; they count toward the 60. starting.effect is left empty (several Effects start; the strategy's 'Start OuneeTa instead of YISYW' vs MKOS names no single fixed starting Effect).

Posted 'Profit From This Or Be Destroyed' dested You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed; 'Jabba's Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Home One DB', 'Tatooine DB', 'Hoth DB' dested Home One: Docking Bay, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Hoth: Echo Docking Bay.

Posted 'Red Leader' and 'Gold Leader' (a two-card block followed by Landing Claw x2) dested the starships Red Leader In Red 1 and Gold Leader In Gold 1: the deck has no other starships, Landing Claw deploys on a starship, and the strategy speaks of holding in space. Red Leader is also a Premiere character.

Posted 'Ben Kenobi's Lightsaber' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; 'Weapon Levitation' dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt Weapon Levitation (Jabba's Palace); 'Boushhh' dested Boushh; 'Taws Khaa' dested Tawss Khaa; 'EPP Leia' / 'EPP Han' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle / Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Jedi Knight Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Force Is Strong With This One' dested The Force Is Strong With This One; 'Ounee-Ta' dested Ounee Ta.
Posted 'Yoda Stew/You Do Have Your Moments', 'Alter/Friendly Fire' and 'Bith Shuffle/Desperate Reach' dested the Reflections II combo interrupts.
The strategy opens with '*Take out The Signal, put in SATM'; the list is kept as posted (The Signal stays).
